calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark instrument, fade its completed three-session return relative to the same-date cross-sectional median, scaled by its trailing 20-session daily-return volatility. Cross-sectional median requires at least 8 valid instruments. All inputs are lagged/completed bars.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC and ICIR in 2020-2022 (0.055357/0.167173), 2023-2024 (0.036273/0.108614), and 2025-2026 (0.041886/0.131229). Small 15-instrument cross-section warrants conservative uncertainty interpretation.
